builder.title: Portfolio Analysis
builder.subtitle: Build a weighted portfolio; measure its risk and return with real data.
builder.noPortfoliosYet: You haven't created a portfolio yet.
builder.atLeastOneAssetRequired: At least one asset must be selected
builder.chartAriaLabel: Performance chart of the {{name}} portfolio over time
builder.noBenchmark: BIST 100 benchmark data couldn't be fetched right now; the portfolio index is shown on its own.

shared.title: Shared Portfolio
shared.subtitle: A read-only, public analysis view of this portfolio.
shared.readOnlyNote: This is a read-only view a portfolio owner shared with you. It contains no holdings or cost-basis information.

taxReport.title: Tax Report
taxReport.subtitle: Realized gain/loss summary by year — computed automatically from your existing sale records, not an official document.
taxReport.empty: You don't have any recorded sales yet.

allocation.title: Asset Allocation
allocation.chartAriaLabel: Pie chart showing the portfolio's asset allocation

exposure.title: Sector & Currency Breakdown
exposure.intro: Sector and currency breakdown weighted by the portfolio's own weights — shows whether diversification is real exposure, not just asset count.

optimization.title: Portfolio Optimization
optimization.needsTwoAssets: Optimization requires at least two assets in the portfolio.
optimization.introPrefix: Based on the portfolio's historical daily returns, weights are suggested that
optimization.introRiskParity: equalize each asset's share of total risk (balancing risk, not return)
optimization.introSuffix: (no short selling, each asset between 0-100%). This is a suggestion — past performance doesn't guarantee future returns.
optimization.frontierIntro: Efficient frontier: the lowest-volatility / highest-expected-return combinations reachable with the same assets at different weights. The current and suggested portfolio's position on this curve is shown below.

frontierChart.chartAriaLabel: Efficient frontier chart: expected return vs. volatility, with the current and suggested portfolio points

correlation.title: Correlation Matrix
correlation.needsTwoAssets: Correlation requires at least two assets in the portfolio.
correlation.intro: The relationship between assets' daily returns. Dark green (low/negative correlation) indicates a diversification benefit; dark red (high correlation) indicates assets move together.

alerts.deepDrawdown: The portfolio has seen a drawdown of up to {{percent}}% in the past.
alerts.negativeSharpe: Risk-adjusted return (Sharpe ratio) is negative — the risk taken isn't paying off.
alerts.highCorrelation: {{tickerA}} and {{tickerB}} are highly correlated ({{value}}) — limited diversification benefit.

rebalancing.title: Rebalancing Suggestions
rebalancing.intro: Shown here when your positions' current values drift from the target weights you set when building the portfolio (if the difference exceeds 2 percentage points).

stressTest.title: Scenario / Stress Test
stressTest.intro: The portfolio's historical beta relative to the BIST 100: {{beta}}. The estimates below are based on this historical relationship — not a guarantee, a rough estimate.

riskMetrics.title: Advanced Risk Metrics
riskMetrics.intro: Beyond standard volatility and the Sharpe ratio, these complementary measures show the shape of the return distribution and how the portfolio performs through drawdowns.

backtest.title: Backtest
backtest.intro: The distribution of returns from every possible {{window}}-length starting point in the portfolio's real historical price series — this isn't a simulation, it's the actual outcomes of periods that really happened in the portfolio's own history.
backtest.insufficientData: Not enough historical data for this window (at least {{days}} trading days required).

monteCarlo.title: Monte Carlo Simulation
monteCarlo.insufficientData: Not enough historical price data for the simulation (at least ~20 trading days required).
monteCarlo.intro: {{count}} random scenarios are generated from the constituents' historical returns and correlation structure to estimate a likely value range over {{horizon}} (base=100, on the same scale as today's portfolio index). Real cross-asset correlation is taken into account. This is not a guarantee — it's a statistical estimate.

goalPlanning.title: Goal Planning
goalPlanning.intro: {{count}} scenarios are generated from the constituents' historical returns and correlation structure, together with regular monthly contributions, to estimate when you might reach your goal. This is not a guarantee — it's a statistical estimate; actual future returns may differ.
goalPlanning.insufficientData: The simulation needs a valid, positive target amount and enough historical price data (at least ~20 trading days).

comparison.title: Compare Portfolios
comparison.intro: See more than one portfolio's index (base=100) side by side on the same chart.
comparison.loadFailed: Couldn't load analysis for the selected portfolios.
comparison.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one portfolio to compare.

holdings.title: Positions
holdings.intro: Record the purchases you've made for this portfolio; cost, current value, and profit/loss are computed automatically. <link>Dividend Calendar →</link>
holdings.mixedCurrencyNote: This portfolio holds positions in different currencies; the totals above are combined by converting to TRY at a current exchange rate.
holdings.fxUnavailableNote: Some positions couldn't be included in the total since an exchange rate wasn't available.
holdings.empty: No positions have been added to this portfolio yet.
